tasks.question: In Python 3.12, with asyncio.gather(fail(), slow()) default options, when fail() raises ValueError quickly, is slow() cancelled or does it continue and typically write its log after 2 seconds?
In Python 3.12, with asyncio.TaskGroup creating fail() and slow() concurrently, when fail() raises ValueError, is slow() cancelled and does it typically fail to write its log?
What is the difference in exception type/shape between asyncio.gather default and asyncio.TaskGroup when one child raises ValueError (e.g., bare ValueError vs ExceptionGroup)?
What boundary conditions matter: return_exceptions, CancelledError handling in slow(), event loop staying alive 3 seconds, no external cancellation, and timing of cancellation delivery?
What do the Python 3.12 official asyncio documentation pages say about gather, TaskGroup, cancellation, and exception groups as the basis for this comparison?
